combos.why: Patterns that suit it: large soft shapes (fades, blocks): sit above without touching the sawtooth; thin outline or pinstripe: can follow the divide
Patterns to avoid: other stripe, hatch or two-tone patterns: the diagonals and split collide; glitter and flake: busy over a loud base
Spec overlays that work: gloss clearcoat on a number block: smooth patch against the satin; none elsewhere: it already has full metal
Judge the paint and the shine together: the same spec looks different under different colours.

articles.title: Color Clash: Fever Dream
articles.summary: Concentric swirl of purple and pink rings spiralling from the centre, fine satin sparkle. Reads as a purple and red-pink vortex, a single big swirl that dominates the panel, loud and psychedelic.
articles.what: Fever red center into hallucination purple edges — multi-finish 4 zones Up close: One big hypnotic spiral of alternating violet and coral-red bands, 10-14 px wide, winding out from a pinwheel centre, with a fine diagonal pale crosshatch of scratch lines over it. A visible horizontal seam runs left from the centre where the spiral wraps. From a distance: Reads as a purple and red-pink vortex, a single big swirl that dominates the panel, loud and psychedelic. Measured spec (average): metal 222, roughness 68, coat 228. Shine: satin. Metal: full. It brings its own colours.
when: Best on: hood, roof, hero panel.
Fits: show car, gt / sports car, stock car.
how: Click the zone you want to change.
Click the BASE MATERIAL box (it says "Click to choose a base") and type "Color Clash: Fever Dream" in the SEARCH FINISHES box.
Click it to open the big preview, then click Apply.
Leave BASE COLOR on Use finish's own color to keep its colours.
Render and judge it on the car, not on the swatch.
tips: Hood or roof: the spiral needs a large flat panel with its centre in the middle
Avoid doors with window cuts, they slice the spiral
Numbers must sit on a plate with thick outline; the high-contrast bands swallow ordinary numbers.
Almost nothing: it is a hero graphic; keep a plain number plate
Pairs well with: black, chrome, white, gold.
pitfalls: Not a repeating all-over pattern: it is one placed spiral (a single motif), so position matters
Not a smooth gradient: the bands are hard and striped
Avoid: numbers over the swirl centre, next to other patterned finishes.
articles.spec_character: Average spec: metal 222 (true metallic), roughness 68 (satin gloss), clearcoat 228 (almost no clearcoat). The spec is textured, not flat: metal and roughness vary by 20 or more across the surface.

combos.why: Patterns that suit it: almost nothing: it is a hero graphic; keep a plain number plate; black or white outline stripes at the edges of the panel: frames the vortex
Patterns to avoid: any other pattern: it destroys the spiral

articles.title: Color Clash: Flash Burn
articles.summary: Bright orange satin with a wavy white-hot band across the middle, fine diagonal weave texture, chrome-to-rough gradient edges. Reads as bright orange with a white-hot zig-zag streak through the middle, like a flame lick or heat haze; the lattice blurs to a glowing mesh shimmer.
articles.what: Flash white center searing into burn orange-red edges — chrome to rough Up close: Burnt-orange field with a wavy white-hot band, 80-120 px wide, snaking across the middle. Over everything lies a fine criss-cross lattice of bright diagonal hairlines plus faint concentric ring ripples, like woven wire mesh or interference moire. Dark rust gaps show between the lines. From a distance: Reads as bright orange with a white-hot zig-zag streak through the middle, like a flame lick or heat haze; the lattice blurs to a glowing mesh shimmer. Measured spec (average): metal 219, roughness 84, coat 234. Shine: satin. Metal: full. It brings its own colours.
when: Best on: body, hero panel, sides.
Fits: gt / sports car, open wheel, show car.
how: Click the zone you want to change.
Click the BASE MATERIAL box (it says "Click to choose a base") and type "Color Clash: Flash Burn" in the SEARCH FINISHES box.
Click it to open the big preview, then click Apply.
Leave BASE COLOR on Use finish's own color to keep its colours.
Render and judge it on the car, not on the swatch.
tips: Sides and doors: the band runs along the length
Hood: the white streak reads as a hero stripe
Black numbers with an outline read on the orange; on the white band they are fine, but orange numbers vanish.
Bold black or charcoal stripes, numbers and graphics: contrast on orange
Pairs well with: black, gunmetal, white, carbon.
pitfalls: Not a smooth gradient: criss-cross lattice covers the whole thing
Not matte: full metal satin
Avoid: busy numbers over the white band, next to other orange finishes.
